staleness_rules: If an evidence id in an entry becomes INVALID, WITHDRAWN or its claim becomes UNVERIFIED, the entry MUST be marked BLOCKED before the next commit.
If a baseline is SUPERSEDED or STALE, every entry drawing on it becomes STALE, not merely BLOCKED: STALE means the numbers were right once and may no longer be.
A claim whose evidence is STALE or INVALID cannot remain VERIFIED. Enforced by test_04_claim_binding.py::test_BIND05_stale_baseline_blocks_claims.
